newsitem.title: USA: Universal Turf Inc acquires In En Tec.
newsitem.headline: Universal Turf Inc acquires In En Tec.

text.p: Universal Turf Inc said on Monday it acquired the In En Tec Corp of Botkins, Ohio as a wholly-owned subsidiary in a cash and stock combination.
In En Tec houses an automated Granutech plant system -- it has a certified engineer's appraisal of $1.019 million. The acquisition will add $1.2 million in total assets to Universal's balance sheet.
Universal Turf deals in the tire recycling industry.
